Translation: I seek refuge in the majesty of Your noble face
from the month of Ramadan passing from me

Arabic text: أَوْ يَطْلُعَ الْفَجْرُ مِنْ لَيْلَتِيْ هٰذِهِ
Translation: or the dawn of this night breaking

Arabic text: وَلَكَ قِبَلِيْ تَبِعَةٌ أَوْ ذَنْبٌ تُعَذِّبُنِيْ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: while I still have a sin or wrongdoing for which You may punish me
